rules.why: A drawer's tables fit the drawer: the Conditions table, a workload's, a claim's, a volume's and a node's pods, a StorageClass's claims, a Service's ports and EndpointSlices and a VPA's tables are 640 px at their narrowest with their columns rebalanced, where v0.7.7 cut their last columns and headers ("Last Transiti") at the drawer's edge.
Teams, Roles and Clusters have a search box above their list, which takes a row of the fitted table.

self has no metrics-server and its metrics reads now say so (a 404, not an empty list): Monitoring shows the page's "Metrics server not available for this cluster" above the tab's "not available", and the Nodes page's top card says it in place of "No metrics available".

Cluster View pages its node boxes ten at a time, so the list footer (the range shown and Prev / Next) is under the boxes on every cluster; with more than one page the map outlines the cells of the page shown. The line under the map's legend, which names the cell the pointer or a key is on, says a count of one in the singular ("1 pod", "1 error", "1 warning"), where v0.7.7 said "1 pods".

With Fit the Alerts inbox's first page holds the rows that end inside its table, each at its own height (its rows wrap to different heights), where v0.7.7 took the first row's height for every row and held a page to five rows at least; the footer's range and pages are counted at that size.
